rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par gzugs myed pa'i snyoms7par 'jug pa rnams 'dus pa lags/ ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par rnam par thar pa rnams 'dus pa lags/ ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'dus pa lags/ ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa 'dus pa lags/ ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par mngon par shes pa rnams 'dus pa lags/ ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par ting nge 'dzin rnams 'dus pa lags/ ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'dus pa lags/ ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams 'dus pa lags/ ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par myi 'jigs pa rnams 'dus pa lags/ ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par so so yang dag par rig pa rnams 'dus pa lags/ ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par byams pa chen po 'dus pa lags/ ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par snying rje chen poshe'adus pa lags/ ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams 'dus pa lags/bcom ldan 'das de ltar mtshan nyid kyang tha dad la 'di lta gho/ mtshan nyid ma mchis par mtshan nyid gcig par gyur pa de dag rnam pa ji lta bur gdags par 'gyur/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/spyi lam lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing / sbyin pa yongs su 21—809

gtong ngo / /tshul khrims srung ngo / /bzod pa sgom mo/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo//ting nge 'dzin sgom mo/ /shes rab sgom mo/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /tshul khrims srung ngo / /bzod pa sgom mo/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /ting nge 'dzin sgom mo/ /shes rab sgom mo/ /snyig rgyu lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing /sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /tshul khrims srung ngo / /bzod pa sgom mo/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /ting nge 'dzin sgom mo/ /shes rab sgom mo/ /chu zla lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /tshul khrims srung ngo / /bzod pa sgom mo/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /ting nge 'dzin sgom mo/ /shes rab sgom mo/ /myig yor lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /tshul khrims srung ngo / /bzod pa sgom mo/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /ting nge 'dzin sgom mo/ /shes rab sgom mo/ /sgra brnyan lta bu'i ①nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing /sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /tshul khrims srung ngo / /bzod pa sgom mo/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /ting nge 'dzin sgom mo/ /shes rab sgom mo/ /gzugs brnyan lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /tshul khrims srung ngo / /bzod pa sgom mo/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo//ting nge 'dzin sgom mo/ /shes rab sgom mo/ /dri za'i grong khyer lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /tshul khrims srung ngo / /bzod pa sgom mo/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /ting nge 'dzin sgom mo//shes rab sgom mo/ /sprul pa lta bu'i〈nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing /24—810

sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /tshul khrims srung ngo / /bzod pa sgom mo/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /ting nge 'dzin sgom mo/ /shes rab sgom mo/ /de 'di ltar rtog ste/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga ni spyi lam lta bu ste/ mtshan nyid myed pa'o / /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga ni sgyu ma lta bu ste/ mtshan nyid myed pa'o/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga ni snyig rgyunyelta bu ste/ mtshan nyid myed pa'o/ /nye bar len pa'i phung7po lngasheni chu zla lta bu ste/ mtshan nyid myed pa'o/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga ni myig yor lta bu ste/ mtshan nyid myed pa'o/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga ni sgra brnyan lta bu ste/ mtshan nyid myed pa'o/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga ni gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ mtshan nyid myed pa'o/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga ni/ dri za'i grong khyer lta bu ste/ mtshan nyid myed pa'o/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga ni/ sprul pa lta bu ste/ mtshan nyid myed pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ spyi lam la rang bzhin gang yang myed do/ /sgyu ma la rang bzhin gang yang myed do/ /smig rgyu la rang bzhin gang yang myed do/ /chu zla la rang bzhin gang yang myed do/ /myig yor la rang bzhin gang yang myed do/ /sgra brnyan la rang bzhin gang yang myed do/ /gzugs brnyan la rang bzhin gang yang myed do/ /dri za'i grong khyer la rang bzhin gang yang myed do/ /sprul pa la rang bzhin gang yang myed do/ /gang la rang bzhin myed pa de la mtshan nyid myed do/ /dugang la mtshan nyid myed pa de ni/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid myed par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o zhes bya bar rtogs par byed de/ rab 'byor rnam grangs des na/khyod kyis 'di ltar rig par bya ste/ sbyin pa ni mtshan nyid myed pa'o/ /gtong ba ni mtshan nyid myed pa'o/ /len pa ni mtshan nyid myed pa'o zhes bya bar shes 24—811

par bya ste/ gang de ltar shes nas7sbyin pa gtong ba de ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa yin te/ de sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed na/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las phyir myi ldog go / /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa las phyir myi ldog go/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las phyir myi ldog go/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa las phyir myi ldog go/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las phyir myi ldog go/ /de pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dgashel gnas shing / bsam gtan bzhi yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /tshad myed pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /dbang po lnga yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /stobs lnga yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun yongs su rdzogs par byed do//'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do / /phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /24—812

dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /myi dmyigs7pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /dngos po skyed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin yongs su rdzogs par byed do//mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /mngon par shes pa lnga yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo lnga brgya yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /byams pa chen po yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /snying rje chen po yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /de 'phags pa'i chos byang ba 'jig rten las 'das pa thun ②mong ma yin pa rnam par smin pa las byung ba rnams la gnas shing / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad myed grangs myed dpag tu myed pa dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa de dag gi 24—813

drung du/ rdzu 'phrul gyis song zhing na bza' dang / bsod snyoms dang /gzims cha dang / snyun gyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad mang pos bsnyen bkur byed de/ longs spyod dang / skyid pa thams cad kyis kyang sems can rnams kyi don byed do/ /de na sems can gang sbyin pas yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang sbyin pas yongs su sdud do/ /gang tshul khrims kyis yongs su bsdu ①ba de dag kyang tshul khrims kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang bzod pas yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang bzod pas yongs su sdud do/ /gang brtson 'grus kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang brtson 'grus kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang ting nge 'dzin gyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang ting nge 'dzin gyis yongs su sdud ②do/ /gang shes rab kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / shes rab kyis yongs su sdudakyedo/ /gang nang stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu0ba de dag kyang nang stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang phyi stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / phyi stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang phyi nang stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang phyi nang stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdudakyido/ /gang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang chen po stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang chen po stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang don dam pa stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang don dam pa stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang mtha' 24—814

las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang rang ①bzhin stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang yang dag par spong ba rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang yang dag par spong ba rnams kyis7yongs su sdud do//gang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang dbang po rnams kyis yongs su bsdu 24—815

ba de dag kyang dbang po rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang stobs rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang stobs rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang lam gyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang lam gyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang bsam gtan rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang bsam gtan rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang tshad myed pa rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang tshad myed pa rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang rnam par thar pa rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang rnam par thar pa rnams kyis yongs su sdud7do/ /gang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis yongs su sdud do / /gang rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pas yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pas yongs su sdud do/ /gang mngon par shes pa rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / mngon par shes pa rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang ting nge 'dzin rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang ting nge 'dzin rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis 24—816

yongs su sdud do/ /gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang myi 'jigs pa rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / myi 'jigs pa rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang byams pa chen pos yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang byams pa chen pos yongs su sdud do/ /gang snying rje chen pos yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang snying rje chen pos yongs su sdud do/ /gang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bus yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bus yongs su sdud do/ /gang lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bus yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bus yongs su sdud do/ /gang phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bus yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bus yongs su sdud do/ /gang dgra bcom pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang dgra bcom pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang rang byang chub kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang rang byang chub kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /gang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis yongs su sdud do/ /de ltar gang dang gang dge ba'i chos gang dang gang gis yongs su bsdu ba de dag kyang / dge ba'i chos de dang de dag gis yongs su sdud 24—817

do / /de dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag dang ldan zhing chos thams cad la dbang sgyuratubs / 'khor ba nye bar len kyang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis myi gos te/ de sems can rnams kyi don du myi dang lha'i phun sum tshogs pa nye bar len te②/phun sum tshogs pa de dag gis sems can rnams yongs su sdud do/ /de chos thams cad mtshan nyid myed par shes pas/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu shes kyang de la myi gnas so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu shes kyang de la myi gnas so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu shes kyang de la myi gnas so/ /dgra bcom pa nyid shes kyang de la myi gnas so/ /rang byang chub shes kyang de la mi gnas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des chos thams cad shes par bya gho/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par bya ba'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni chos thams cad mtshan nyid myed par shes pas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan nyid med par shes so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan nyid myed par shes sol/ /nang stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myedarnyupar shes so/ /phyi stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /chen po stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par 21—818

shes so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mtshan nyid ⑦skyed par shes so/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa ②stong pa nyid mtshan nyid skyed par shes so/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mtshan nyid skyed par shes so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /dbang po rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /stobs rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pasamatshan nyid skyed par shes so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /bsam gtan rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /tshad myed pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rnam par thar pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa mtshan nyid myed 21—819

par shes so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ / myi 'jigs pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /①so so yang dag par rig pa rnams mtshan nyid skyed par shes so/ /byams pa chen po mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /snying rje chen po mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /dgra bcom pa nyid mtshan nyid skyed par shes so/ /rang byang chub mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /lam gyi rnam pasheshes pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mi⑧lam lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ sgyu ma lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ smig rgyu lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ chu zla lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ myig yor lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ sgra brnyan lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ gzugs brnyan lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ dri za'i grong khyer lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ sprul pa lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rab 'byor byang 24—820

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de yang nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga rmi ①lam lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sgyu ma lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga smigakhurgyu lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga chu zla lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga myig yor lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sgra brnyan lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga gzugs brnyan lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga dri za'i grong khyer lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sprul pa lta bur shes nas/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan nyid myed pa/ ma zhig pa/ ma ral ba/ skyon myed pa/ rnyog pa myed pa/nyams pa myed pa/ dbang du gyur pa②/ mkhas pas bsngags pa/ shin tu rdzogs pa/ 'phags par gyur pa/ zag pa myed pa/ lam gyi khongs su chud pa/'jig rten las 'das pa/ yongs su rdzogs par byed deme/ de la gnas shing yang dag par blang ba'i brda dang ldan pa'i tshul khrims dang / chos nyid kyis thob pa'i tshul khrims dang / sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / dmyigs pa'i tshul khrims dang / spyad pa'i tshul khrims dang / myi spyad pa'i tshul khrims srung ngo / /de tshul khrims de lta bu dang ldan yang0'dis bdag rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba'i rigs dang skal ba mnyam pa'am/ bram ze che zhing mtho ba'i rigs dang skal ba mnyam pa'am/ khyim bdag che zhing mtho ba'i rigs dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar bya'o zhe'am/ rgyal phran nam/ 'khor los sgyur7ba'i rgyal por 'gyur bar bya'o zhe'am/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar bya'o zhe'am/ sum cu rtsa gsum mamanya/ mtshe ma'am/ dga' ldan nam/'phrul dga' 'am/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang skal ba/mnyam 24—821

par skye bar bya'o zhe'am/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par bya'o zhe'am/lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam/ rang byang chub bam/ byang chub thob par bya'o zhes tshul khrims des snyems pa myed do/ ljade ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos thams cad ni mtshan nyid myed pa ste/ 'di ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyidashedu mtshan nyid gcig pasalgen mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos kyis mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos thob par myi rung ngo / /mtshan nyid tha dad pa'i chos kyis kyang mtshan nyid tha dad pa'i chos thob par myi rung ngo / /mtshan nyid tha dad pa'am/ mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos kyis kyang / mtshan nyid tha dad pa'am/ mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos thob par myi rung ngo / /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan nyid myed pa yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug go/ /byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug pa'i tshe/ myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa 'thob stedzo/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i mngon par shes pa lnga rab tu thob nas/ gzungs kyi sgo lnga brgya dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo lnga brgya la gnas te/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la bsnyen bkur byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro ste/ sems can rnams kyang yongs su smin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su 'dzin to/ /de 'gro ba lnga'i 'khor ba na 'khor yang /'khor ba'i las rnam par smin pas gos par myi 'gyur te/ 'di ltar dper na/24—822

sprul pa ni 'gro ba'am/① sdod pa'am/ 'dug pa'am/ nyal ba byed kyang de la 'gro ba'am/ 'ong ba'am/ sdod pa'am/ 'dug pa'am/ nyal ba yang myi dmyigs te/ de sems can rnams kyi don kyang byed do/ /sems can dang sems can du btags pa yang myi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shin tu zhi ba zhes bya ba/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ sems can tshad myed pa theg pa gnyis kyis yongs su mya ngan las bzlasasakyang gang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par bya ba'i⑧byang chub sems dpa' de lta bu gang yang ma gzigs nas/ des che'i 'du byed spangs nas sprul pa sprul pa mdzad de/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /rab 'byor de ltar sprul pa des bskal pa gcig lon nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan te/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur to/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa de'i gzugs sam/tshor ba'am/ 'du shes sam/ 'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa'am/dngos po gang yang dmyigs su myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang sems can nam sems can du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs la/ sems can rnams kyi don yang byed de/ rab 'byor de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mtshan nyid myed pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 24—823

yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de yongs su rdzogs pas ①mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos thams cad khong du7chud par shes so/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshedu/rmi dulam lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ sgra brnyan lta bu dang / chu zla lta bu dang ( myig yor lta bu dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smigakyirgyu lta bu dang / dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang /du sprul pa lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga ⑨la gnas te/ mtshan nyid myed pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams la gnas shing / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa gnyis kyis/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ gnyis gang zhe na/ nyams su len pa'i bzod pa dang / chos khong du chud pa'i bzod pa'o/ /de la nyams su len pa'i bzod pa gang zhe na/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/snying po byang chub la 'dug gi bar du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du gal te sems can thams cad yang dang yang 'ongs shing gshe ba'am/myi snyan par brjod7cing ma klas pa'i tshig brlang ba7zer bar gyur tam/ rdo dbyug dang / mtshon chas7brdegs sam/ btab kyang de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'dod pas/ sems bskyed pa 'ga' tsam 8yang 'khrug〈nyepa dang ldan pa'am/gnod sems dang ldan pa bskyed par myi bya ste/ phyir sems can de dag la kye ma/24—824

sems can 'di dag ni nyon mongs pa'i nad kyis mnar ba ste/ 'di dag la bdag gis sdig stito'i sems myi skyed②kyi/ 'di ni bdag nyid kyis phung po ③dgrar gyur pa 'di rnams blangs pa'i lan to zhes de dag la lhag par snying rjekyibaskyed par bya'o/ /byams pa dang ldan te/ snying rje bar gyur nas/ rnam pa de ltar rtog pa 'di ni nyams su len pa'i bzod pa zhes bya'o/ /de la chos khong du chud pa'i bzod pa gang zhe na/ sems can de dag kyang don dam par dmyigs su myed na/ bdag la gshe ba'amadzo/ myi snyan par brjod7pa'amanya/ ma klas pa'i tshig brlang po zer ba'am/ rdo dbyug gis brdegarwaskrecing mtshon 'debs pa lta su zhig yod de/ 'du byed thams cad ni sgyu ma lta bu gsob gsogatsorag lusalgepa/ nam mkha' lta bu bdag dang sems can dang / srog dang / 'gro ba dang / gso ba dang / skyes bu dang / gang zag dang / shed can dang /shed bdag dang / bral ba ste/ rnam par rtog pa de dag thams cad ni yongs su rtog pa las byung ba yin na/ bdagatsol gshe ba dang / myi snyan par brjod7pa dang / ma klas pa'i tshig brlang bar5)zer ba dang / rdo dbyug gis rdeganyecing mtshon 'debs pa lta su zhig yod do/ /zhu bdag gis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid nye bar bzung ste/ de ltar rnam par brtag par myi bya'o zhes bya ba 'di ni chos khong du chud pa'i bzod pa zhes bya ste/ de de ltar yongs su rtog cing / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa des myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa 'thob bo/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa zhes bgyi ba ni gang lags/ de la spangs pa ni ci mchis/24—825

ye shes ni ci mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor chos gang la rdul tsam yang skye ba myed pa de ni myi skye ba'o/ /de gang gis shes pa de ni bzod pa zhes bya ste/ shes pa des myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa 'thob bo /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa gang lags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa gang lags pa'i bzod pa de dag la bye brag tu bgyi ba ci mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor rgyun tu zhugs pa'i shes pa gang yin pa dang / spang btugang yin pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'o/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i shes pa gang yin pa dang / spang bsnyegang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'o/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i shes pa gang yin pa dang / spang bshegang yin pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa'i shes pa gang yin pa dang / spang btugang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'o / /rang sangs rgyas kyi shes pa gang yin pa dang / spang bsnyegang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa ste/ rab 'byor de ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi bzod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa'i bye brag yin no/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni bzod pa de lta bu dang ldan pas nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad zil kyis gnon te/ de rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i myi skye ba'i chos kyi bzod pa la gnas te/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam la spyod cing /24—826

lam gyi rnam par shes pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de yongs su rdzogs pas/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi7chos sum cu7rtsa bdun dang / stong pa nyid dang ske/ mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams dang myi 'bral ba yin/ de mngon par shes pa lnga dang myi 'bral ba yin/ de mngon par shes pa rnams dang myi 'bral bas/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed pa yin/ de sems can rnams yongs su smin par byas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byas nas / skad cig gcigashedang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par byed de/ rab 'byor de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mtshan nyid myed pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mi⑧lam lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas / sgra brnyan lta bu dang / chu zla lta bu dang /yi myig yor lta bu dang /sgyu ma lta bu dang / rtsig rgyu lta bu dang / dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang /la sprul pa lta bu'i nye bar7len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing / lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /de lus kyi brtson 'grus kyis7rdzu 'phrul/ mngon par sgrub ste/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dag tu song nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la bsnyen bkur byed cing /sems can rnams kyi don byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do / /de lus kyi brtson 'grus des sems can rnams yongs su smin par byas 24—827

nas/ theg pa gsum la 'dzud cing rab tu 'god do/ /①rab 'byor de ltar na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mtshan nyid myed pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /de7sems kyi brtson 'grus zag pa myed pa/ lamakhugyi yan lag tu gyur pa/ lam gyi khongs su chud pas/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang du dge ba'i chos thams cad 'di lta ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rju 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang /dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang /bsamakhugatan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /myi 'jigasalgepa bzhishedang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad yongs su 'dus pa yongs susnyerdzogs par byed de/ de la spyod cing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /⑨de yongs su rdzogs pas/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad spangs par 'gyur ro/ /bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad spangs nas/ mtshan phun sum tshogs pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do / /kun tu snang ba thob par byas nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa bcu gnyis rgyud gsum du bskor bskor bar 'gyur ro/ /de bskor bas stong gsum gyi stong 24—828

chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnam pa drug tu g.yo ba dang / rab tu g.yo ba dang / kun nas g.yonyeb dang / 'gul ba dang / rab tu 'gul ba dang /kun nas 'gul ba dang / ldeg pa dang / rab tu ldeg pa dang / kun nas ldeg par 'gyur te/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang snang ba chen pos rgyas par gang bar 'gyur rol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de'i sgra gang du byung zhingakhudabyangs grag par gyur pa'i sgra de stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed kyis duthos pa de thams cad theg pa gsum la nges par 'gyur te/ rab 'byor de ltar phan pa chen po dang7ldan pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ spyi lam lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ sgra brnyan lta bu dang ske/ myig yor lta bu dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smig rgyu lta bu dang / chu zla lta bu dang dzi sprul pa lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mishelam lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ sgra brnyan lta bu dang / myig yor lta bu dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smig rgyu lta bu 24—829

dang ske/ chu zla lta bu dang ༷ sprul pa lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin gyikhupha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs7te gnas so/ /bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar0bsgrubs te gnas so/ /byams pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /snying rje chen po0la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /dga' ba la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /btang snyoms la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgom mo/ /glog lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin sgom mo/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgom mo/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas shingashe/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ma gtogs par nyan thos dang thun mong ba'am/ rang ⑧sangs rgyas khyadang thun mong pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang ji snyed pa dang / gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshogs gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad lus kyis khyab par byas shing / nye bar bsgrubs te gnas kyang /ting nge 'dzin de dag dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i 'bras bu'i ro myong bar〈nyemyi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' 21—830

sems dpa' chen po des/ ting nge 'dzin de dag gi7mtshan nyid myed pa dang /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid du shes pas na/ mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos kyi ro myong bar byed par yang ga la 'gyur/ dngos po myed pa'i chos kyang dngos po myed pa'i chos kyi ②ro myong bar byed pa nig la 'gyur te/de⑥ro myong bar byed pa myed pas/ ting nge 'dzin gang gis dbang gis kyang gzugs kyi khams sam/ gzugs myed pa'i khams su skye bar myi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar des khams de gnyis kyang myi dmyigs/ gang snyoms par 'jug pa dang / gang gis snyoms par 'jug pa de yang myi dmyigs so/ /de myi dmyigs pas mtshan nyid skyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rold tu phyind pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa des/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las yongs su 'da'o/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po0ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyis shing / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las yongs su 'da' ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ nang stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs ⑧pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs ⑨pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs tunyepa dang /chen po stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabasalgepa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs 8pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs 8pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabasalgepa dang / mtha' las 24—831

'das pa stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs7pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabasalgepa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs ③pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang /chos thams cad stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyidashel shin tu bslabs7pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabasalgepa dang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa'i phyir te⑩/ stong pa nyid 'di dag la ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam/ rang byang chub bam/gang la gnas par bya ba'i 8chos de lta bu gang yang myi dmyigs te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya ba de yang stong pa nyid rnams kyis stong ste/stong pa nyid de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 8shin tu 'das nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug go/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i skyon ni gang lags/ skyon ma mchis pa ni gang lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor dmyigs pa thams cad ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i skyon no/ /myi dmyigs pa thams cad ni skyon myed pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dmyigs pa ni gang lags8/ myi dmyigs pa ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 24—832

dmyigs pa'o/ /rab 'byor tshor ba ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'du shes ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'du byed ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /①snyig dang gzugs ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /rna ba dang sgra ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /sna dang dri ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /lce dang ro ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /lus dang reg bya ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /yid dang chos ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa ni dmyigs pa'o//lce'i 'dus te reg pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /yid kyi 'dus 24—833

te reg pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /sa'i khams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /chu'i khams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /mye'i khams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rlung gi khams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /nam mkha'i khams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /ma rig pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /'du byed ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /mying dang gzugs ni dmyigs pa'o/ /skye mched drug ni dmyigs pa'o/ /reg pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /tshor ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /sred pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /len pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /srid pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /skye ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rga shi ni dmyigs pa'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa'o①/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa'o②/ /nang stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o//phyi stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /chen po stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o / /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o / /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni 21—834

dmyigs pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni dmyigs pa'o / /dbang po rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /stobs rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /bsam gtan rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /tshad myed pa rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad7ni dmyigs pa'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni dmyigs pa'o/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni dmyigs pa'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni ②dmyigs pa'o/ /byams pa chen po ni dmyigs pa'o/ /snying rje chen po ni dmyigs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni dmyigs pa'o/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni dmyigs pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rang byang chub ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid nishedamyigs pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni 24—835

dmyigs pa ste skyon no/ /rab 'byor skyon myed pa ①ni gang la gzugs dang /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dang /myig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid dang /gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg dang / chos dang /myig gi rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang /yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang ske/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / sa'i khams dang / chu'i khams dang / mye'i khams dang / rlung gi khams dang / nam mkha'i khams dang ske/ rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / ma rig pa dang / 'du byed dang /rnam par shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang / reg pa dang / tshor ba dang / sred pa dang / len pa dang / srid pa dang / skye ba dang / rga shi dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi 24—836

nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang ske/ don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang ske/ stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang /bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad myed pa rnams dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang ske/ mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa rnamasatudang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnamasaphudang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub dang / lam gyi 24—837
